verdict.rationale: BugSnag's integrations docs say it can "Create and sync issues in Jira, or your team's issue tracker," so linking errors to tickets is a first-party capability. However, the evidence never details the sync behavior. Nothing confirms that closing a ticket marks the error fixed, or that a regression reopens the linked ticket. missing for 10: documented two-way status sync semantics, ticket-close-resolves-error behavior, regression-reopens-ticket behavior, explicit GitHub Issues and Linear support, hands-on or independent corroboration.
